ModMetaData.name: M3AT: Maru's 3D Animated Toons
ModMetaData.author: maru mirai
ModMetaData.description:
Animated 3D pawns for IsoRim Waylith
Early WIP, Main features: Animations for most actions (some currently basic) Wearable 3D apparel and sprite-to-3D hair Correct holds for IsoRim's 3D weapons, Mod weapon grip approximation Visible holstered weapons and IsoRim equipment Body types, gene parts, Biotech growth, prosthetics Visible injuries and injury-reactive animations Ragdolls and flinging CE support Freecam mode
